name: @pipeworx/mcp-dicebear

tools.name: generate_avatar
tools.description: Generate a custom avatar SVG. Specify a style (e.g., 'avataaars', 'pixel-art', 'lorelei') and seed (e.g., username). Returns the SVG URL ready to display.

style.description: The avatar style to use. Available styles: adventurer, avataaars, bottts, fun-emoji, identicon, initials, lorelei, micah, miniavs, notionists, open-peeps, personas, pixel-art, thumbs.

seed.description: A seed string that determines the avatar appearance. Same seed + style always produces the same avatar.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List all available avatar styles. Returns style names and descriptions—use with generate_avatar to pick a style.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dicebear forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dicebear pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
